desc:
A Webflow management starter sprint gives your site a round of health checks, content updates and small fixes from people who know the platform. Ecom Swift LLC works through your list in your own project and sends a short report of what changed.

## What is a Webflow site management sprint?

A Webflow management sprint is a fixed block of upkeep work on an existing site. We check the project, repair what is broken, then complete a defined list of updates such as new text, images, blog posts, team changes, forms and small design fixes. It is a one-time package, not a subscription.

Many owners have a site that works but nobody has time to look after it. A sprint clears the backlog and leaves you with a clean, current site and a clear idea of what to do next.

## Why a neglected site loses trust quietly

Outdated information is one of the fastest ways to lose a visitor. A team page with someone who left, an event that happened last spring or a price that changed all signal that nobody is minding the shop. Broken links and forms that stopped sending notifications are worse, because they hide the damage.

Search engines also notice stale, broken sites. Pages that load slowly because of oversized images, missing page titles and unattended 404 errors make the site harder to rank and harder to use.

## How steady upkeep affects your results

Regular updates keep the site accurate, which builds confidence in visitors who are deciding whether to contact you. Fresh posts and current offers give them reasons to return. Working forms and correct contact details make sure interested people can actually reach you.

Time is the other benefit. Updating a site yourself takes longer than it seems, especially when you are learning the Editor and Designer. Handing the list to someone experienced frees you for the work only you can do.

## What a good starter sprint includes

- A health check covering links, forms, images, layout and basic search settings.
- Content updates to text, images, buttons, team pages and offers.
- Blog or CMS posts published with images, titles and meta descriptions.
- Image resizing and compression for faster pages.
- Forms tested, with notification emails and routing corrected.
- Small layout fixes on desktop and mobile.
- A saved backup copy before changes begin.
- A short summary report of what was done.
- Review of SEO titles on key pages.
- A plan for what to do next.

## How the sprint works

You send your list of updates by email or in a shared document, in any order. We sort them, ask about anything unclear and begin with the health check so urgent problems come first. Changes are made carefully and checked on desktop and mobile before publishing.

The Basic package covers a health check, a handful of content updates, link and form testing, a backup and a summary report. The Standard package adds a larger list of updates, two published posts, image resizing, form and email routing fixes and small layout work. The Premium package is a full sprint with many updates, several new CMS items, small design improvements, a review of SEO titles and a plan for the following month. Extra updates, a monthly performance snapshot and an accessibility quick check are available as add-ons. Ongoing monthly care is quoted separately.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send updates as one organized list with the page named for each item.
- Provide final text and images rather than rough drafts.
- Tell us which changes are most urgent.
- Say who should receive form notifications.
- Review the summary report and the suggested next steps.

**Avoid:**
- Sending updates one by one in separate messages.
- Asking for large redesign work inside a maintenance package.
- Leaving old team members or prices on the site.
- Uploading very large images without resizing.
- Making your own edits while the sprint is running.

## Who this service is for

This service suits small businesses with a site that nobody has had time to update, founders who built the site and now want expert hands, and teams between agency contracts who need a clean handover. It is also a good way to test working with us before deciding on ongoing support.

## What we need from you

Send your update list, the final text and images, and any priorities. We never need your password. You add us to your Webflow project as a collaborator, and we stay within the access the work needs. When the sprint ends, you can remove us at any time.
